title: BunkPro — Add centered subtitle under Dashboard heading

requirements.summary: Insert a theme-aware, centered subtitle line under the Dashboard heading on the Home Dashboard page without altering existing layout or behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Home Dashboard renders the exact text "Be honest & mark attendance" immediately below the "Dashboard" heading.
The new text is center-aligned, uses a slightly smaller font than the "Dashboard" title, medium font weight, and reduced opacity (~80–90%).
Spacing between the "Dashboard" heading and the new text is present and looks uncluttered on both mobile and desktop widths.
Text uses theme-based colors and remains readable in light and dark modes without using harsh bright colors.
No other Home Dashboard behavior, existing layout sections, or responsiveness changes as a result of this update.

file_operations.description: Add a single new centered subtitle text node directly below the existing "Dashboard" <h1> that displays exactly "Be honest & mark attendance". Style using existing theme-aware text utilities (e.g., muted/foreground-based color), medium font weight, slightly smaller typography than the title, and subtle opacity (~80–90%) with minimal vertical spacing so the header does not look crowded; do not change any existing dashboard logic, responsiveness, or layout structure beyond inserting this single line.
